item.title: py解法.
item.description:
import subprocess

def execute_command(command_list):
    ''' return stdout, stderr   '''

    mysql = subprocess.Popen(
        ['mysql', '-u', 'root'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        bufsize=1
    )

    input_str = '\n'.join(command_list)
    return mysql.communicate(input = input_str)


get_tables = [
    "USE lanqiao;",
    "SHOW TABLES;",
]

table_result, table_error = execute_command(get_tables)
tables = table_result.strip().split('\n')[1:]

key = None
for table in tables:
    get_lines = [
        "USE lanqiao;",
        f"select lanqiao_key from {table};"
    ]

    line_result, _ = execute_command(get_lines)
    final_result = line_result.split('\n')
    if len(final_result) > 1:
        key = final_result[1]

print(f"done, key is {key}")

with open("key.txt", mode = "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(key)
